summary.headline: Codex IV and Iohannes Xerokalitos
summary.text: Description of Codex IV, a 1495 Neapolitan paper manuscript of 530 folios assembled from diverse codices and richly furnished with diagrams, figures, and images. Iohannes Xerokalitos identifies himself as its compiler and copyist, and a subscription records completion on 23 June 1495; the entry also cites Cyrillus and notes material beyond judicial astrology.
